LongFormSections.Title: Scope, objectives and priorities
Body: Our work on commercial domiciliation and mail handling starts with a precise review of your flows and operating model so we can define a clear scope, realistic timeline, and priorities that make a measurable difference. In Geneva, Lausanne and French-speaking Switzerland, we work with swiss companies, subsidiaries, foreign entrepreneurs and holdings who want to secure domiciliation without adding internal complexity or losing visibility on key decisions. The core deliverables typically cover registered address, mail handling, scanning and admin coordination, with an ongoing focus on data quality and traceability. We embed requirements tied to commercial register, substance requirements and local obligations from the beginning to avoid late-stage fixes and compliance risk. Depending on your context, we organize the collection of articles of association, address proofs and domiciliation contracts and implement simple routines to keep records complete and reliable.

We rely on mail tracking, alerts and secure digital vault when they add clarity, while staying compatible with your current stack if you prefer a hybrid approach.
